name: Mobile app
note: The vendor's own iOS or Android app
summary: The agent is reached through the vendor's own iOS or Android app, signed in to the same account as on desktop and web. Mobile apps often expose only part of the agent: some tasks need a desktop or keep running on the vendor's servers.
how: User installs the vendor's app and signs in
Requests reach the same agent and account as on desktop
Work that outlives the session runs on the vendor's side, if supported
facts: ChatGPT (dots), Perplexity Comet, Gemini in Chrome on Android
Comet for Android: background work not supported yet
Always at hand, but small screens make review and take-over harder
goodFor: Quick requests and check-ins away from a computer
watchOut: Feature gaps compared with the desktop app
